liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Hell in a Bucket** (2 reviews): Reviewer hears an up-and-down version with many off-kilter, offbeat moments; Solid version in which the band sounds like it's firing on all cylinders [14][22]
- **Dupree's Diamond Blues** (2 reviews): Reviewer calls Dupree's a welcome inclusion; Jerry sounds fairly effective and Bob's backing guitar works, though the bouncy feel lacks an early '70s sound [13][17]
- **Victim or the Crime** (1 review, 1 other source): Cuts off right before the jam, as though equipment problems hit; The third attempt at Victim into Foolish Heart still didn't work out [11][23]
- **Let the Good Times Roll** (1 review): Fun, strong opener, with Brett in particular delivering [22]
- **Cold Rain & Snow** (1 review): Crowd loves the choice; it starts shaky with busy drumming, then gains momentum in the final minute [14]
- **Promised Land** (1 review): Bob forgot a verse, which the reviewer found funny [16]
- **U.S. Blues** (1 other source): Played 325 times in total, three of them on Billy's birthday [5]
- **Foolish Heart** (1 review): Reviewer finds this one rather short [23]

## Setlist highlights

- **Brent Jam**: back after 474 archived shows (2407 days); rare: 3 archived performances [25]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-09-23.nak304.carpenter.88997.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 20 songs; 135 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Good recording, improved by a small EQ adjustment [18]
- **gd1988-09-23.115860.daweez.d5scott.NeumannKMF4.flac16**: source not stated; 20 songs; 133 min [2]. Said about its sound: The first 20 seconds of the opener are in mono [2]
- **gd1988-09-23.164206.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: soundboard; 19 songs; 141 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1988-09-23.140944.OTS.Schoeps.PCM.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1644**: source not stated; 19 songs; 147 min [5]
- **gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 138 min; rated 2.46/5 by 13 [8]. Said about its sound: The recording has a cut about 1 minute 7 seconds into the opener; Reviewer describes the sound quality as good; Good recording, improved by a small EQ adjustment [13][16][19][21]
- **gd1988-09-23.139648.OTS.s2.Schoeps.Oade.Bryant.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: source not stated; 11 songs; 89 min [11]

## Around the show

- Brent's daughters came onstage and sat beside him while he played [15]
- Reviewer's first show; Bob said they always play it on Bobby's birthday, and the band got into it [21]
- Reviewer notes this was the penultimate Madison Square Garden gig of the run [22]
- This was night eight of a nine-night residency [5]
- Night eight of a nine-night run at the arena; it was not Billy's birthday [11]
- Reviewer finds the recording's sound weaker than that of the 9-16-88 show [13]
- By night eight of the run, the reviewer expects only repeated songs, which isn't necessarily bad [14]
- Reviewer rates it an average 1988 show with no mind-expanding jams [16]
- Reviewer calls the opening stretch one of the weakest starts to a Dead show, with a tired band [17]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-09-23.nak304.carpenter.88997.sbeok.flac16**: taped by Ted Carpenter; transferred by Andrew F.; source: Nakamichi CM300's w/CP4 shotguns > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-XG 90's, no Dolby. Mics on stand in OTS [1]
- **gd1988-09-23.115860.daweez.d5scott.NeumannKMF4.flac16**: taped by Da Weez; transferred by D5scott; source: Source: 2 Neumann KMF4 microphones (6th row-center) > Sony TC-D5M - analog master cassettes; [2]. Also: Source is a Neumann KMF4 recording, with d5scott and daweez credited in the file name [2]
- **gd1988-09-23.164206.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac1644**: taped by Recorded by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by Scott Clugston, Charlie Miller, David Minches; source: Ultramatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Multiple UltraMatrix masters were combined to make the show complete, converted from 24/96 to 16/44.1 [3]
- **gd1988-09-23.140944.OTS.Schoeps.PCM.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac.1644**: taped by Don Crandall & Chris Huron; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel and Ted Mattes; source: Recording info: Schoeps CMC3/MK4 > PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100) (Sony ESX-HiFi/L-750 Beta tape); Transfer info: Sony SL-10 > Sony PCM-601ESD > Behringer Ultramatch… [5]. Also: Small digital pops were cleaned up throughout the transfer [5]
- **gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard> Master Cassette> DAT> CD [8]
- **gd1988-09-23.139648.OTS.s2.Schoeps.Oade.Bryant.Gastwirt.Miller.Noel.t-flac16**: taped by Robert Bryant patched out of Oade Brothers - from the Gastwirt collection; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Set 2 Robert Bryant recording (patched out of Oade Brothers): Schoeps CMC4 MK41 > PCM > DAT; Charlie Miller [11]. Also: Taped with Nak 300 mics and CP4 shotguns into a Sony D-5; the DATs suffered water damage, but this one survived [11]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden - September 24, 1988](https://www.dead.net/show/september-24-1988) [26]
- Poster by Jackson: [Grateful Dead Madison Square Garden NYC 1988 King Kong Concert Poster](https://concertposterauction.com/Listing/Details/1099336/Grateful-Dead-Madison-Square-Garden-NYC-1988-King-Kong-Concert-Poster) [27]

citations.author: dire--wolf
citations.quote_or_claim: over all great show. sound qual is not as good as 9-16-88. duprees is a great touch. good times cuts at 1 min 7 sec. other than that, another classic NYC show.…
citations.title: Review: MSG too much too fast (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: jboyaquar
citations.quote_or_claim: 1st Set: Well, by the eighth night we're basically guaranteed all repeats, but that's not necessarily a bad thing as a friendly, light "LTGTR" proves. "Hell"'s…
citations.title: Review: Go for it...there's Not a Dud in this run (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: QuadlibetnotOtherONe
citations.quote_or_claim: One quick note from this show. Brent's daughters came out during Take You Home and sat next to him as he played. Very special moment indeed.
citations.title: Review: Take You Home (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: GratefulDavo
citations.quote_or_claim: Overall show for 1988 was average. The songs that stood out for me LTGTR, Loser, Samson & Delilah, Ship of Fools, I will take you Home, and Stella Blue. Bob…
citations.title: Review: nice show for 1988 (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Nature Boy
citations.quote_or_claim: This is probably the worst beginning of a Dead show I’ve ever heard. Everybody in the band seems disinterested and tired. Jerry and Bob are extremely week on…
citations.title: Review: There are much better shows (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: sbrew
citations.quote_or_claim: Though not much on paper, this show is very good, not a smoker, but well-done and solid.
citations.title: Review: good show (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: thorn726
citations.quote_or_claim: good quality sound on this. my first show. decent, but not great, as most of the other reviews said. US Blues was great for a first encore for me, Bobby says…
citations.title: Review: good quality (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: Ron2112
citations.quote_or_claim: So, it's the penultimate gig at MSG! Reading some of the other reviews, I was expecting a relatively mailed-in performance. But to my ears, that's not the case…
citations.title: Review: Why no love for this one? (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)

citations.author: GrimTaper
citations.quote_or_claim: What happened to the Victim?! Drops off right before the jam as if they had equipment problems. Foolish is also kind of short. Anyone who was there know why?
citations.title: Review: Wha hoppen? (gd88-09-23.sbd.miller.5291.sbeok.shnf)
